title: Better than clouds 2.0
description: An updated take on Better Than Clouds that focuses on quality-of-life improvements, better animations, improved visuals, and a few new crafting recipes.
body: A QoL-focused client modpack that enhances visuals and immersion with smoother animations, improved effects, UI tweaks, and new crafting recipes for Enchanted Golden Apples and maps—no gameplay overhaul.
